title: TOUGEN ANKI: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc
native: 桃源暗鬼 日光・華厳の滝編
synopsis:
After battling in Kyoto and Nerima, the Rasetsu Academy students have grown stronger. But Yaoroshi leaves the academy to join the Oni Brigade for their "the total eradication of the Momotaro."

When Shiki realizes that they also target noncombatants, he sets out after Yaoroshi to bring him back. Meanwhile in Nikko, there's a research facility for horrific experiments atop the old Kegon Falls…

(Source: REMOW)

episodes.title: TOUGEN ANKI: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: Following the intense conflicts in Kyoto and Nerima, Shiki Ichinose and his fellow Rasetsu Academy students return to face a brand-new grueling test: climbing a freezing mountain amidst a harsh blizzard within a 24-hour window, while part-time instructors Hagure Nekosaki and Yu Innami stand in their way.

episodes.title: TOUGEN ANKI: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: As the blizzard intensifies on the mountain, the students must confront both the harsh elements and the formidable instructors standing in their path.

episodes.title: TOUGEN ANKI: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Homare and Shiki reach the summit during the mountain pursuit, followed closely by Juji, Kuina, and Rokuro. Yaoroshi lashes out out of impatience, creating issues for his team as his rogue turn toward the Oni Brigade deepens.
